title: Uchuu no Kishi Tekkaman Blade OVA: Burning Clock
justification: AniList 2299 (OVA, 1 episode, 9 min) is AniDB 1033's special S3 "Burning Clock" (Moeta Tokei), which the Anime-Lists node plus overlay/1033.json place on TVDB 81723 0x02 "Burning Clock" (1998-06-05, the same day AniDB dates S3). The AniList start date 1999-11-30 is wrong: the offline database dates the OVA to spring 1998. TMDB 9155 season 0 lists Burning Clock as its episode 1, Twin Blood as 2, Missing Link as 3; the bridge takes no TMDB value.
